outcome: severe influenza infections requiring critical care
cohort: A cohort of 1,421,531 pregnant women who delivered in Quebec, Canada between 1989 and 2021 were followed over time.
finding: Women with various pregnancy complications, including gestational diabetes, preeclampsia, and preterm birth, had an elevated risk of severe influenza complications and hospitalization later in life.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with a greater risk of influenza hospitalization later in life (HR 1.22, 95% CI 1.13-1.31).
